_about: Hand-written details for the song guide PDF (tools/make_song_guide.py). All songs and artists are fictional. 'sound' lists only instruments and textures that ARE in the song, because the retriever matches sound words against it. 'vocals' says 'none (instrumental)' for songs without singing.

Sunrise City.sound: glossy synth pads, bright synth lead, bouncing electric bass, punchy programmed drums, handclaps, layered backing vocals
Sunrise City.vocals: lead female vocal with a big multi-tracked sing-along chorus
Sunrise City.structure: short synth intro, two verses, a pre-chorus that builds, a soaring chorus, a stripped-down bridge with just bass and vocals, and a final double chorus with extra harmonies
Sunrise City.lyrics: Leaving the city at dawn with friends, the skyline turning gold, and the feeling that the whole day is still ahead.
Sunrise City.listen_when: road trips, getting ready to go out, sunny mornings, any time you want an instant mood lift
Sunrise City.skip_when: you need to concentrate or wind down; the chorus is designed to grab attention
Sunrise City.tip: The bridge drops almost everything out, so the final chorus hits harder on good speakers or in a car.

Midnight Coding.sound: dusty drum loop, muted electric piano chords, warm sub bass, soft rain samples, vinyl crackle
Midnight Coding.structure: a single four-bar loop that repeats with small variations: a filter sweep halfway through and a short break where only the rain and piano remain
Midnight Coding.lyrics: No lyrics. The track title and the rain samples suggest a quiet room late at night with a screen glowing.
Midnight Coding.listen_when: late-night studying or coding, reading, journaling, working on something that needs steady focus
Midnight Coding.skip_when: you want energy or something to sing along to; it is deliberately uneventful
Midnight Coding.tip: Works well on repeat for long sessions because nothing in it demands attention.

Storm Runner.sound: distorted electric guitars, driving bass guitar, pounding live drums with double-time hi-hats, gang vocals in the chorus
Storm Runner.vocals: raw, shouted male lead vocal with gang vocals
Storm Runner.structure: count-in straight into the main riff, two fast verses, explosive choruses, a guitar solo, and an abrupt ending on the last hit
Storm Runner.lyrics: Running headfirst into a storm instead of away from it: pushing past fear, exhaustion and doubt.
Storm Runner.listen_when: workouts, running, lifting, the last push of a hard task
Storm Runner.skip_when: you want calm background music; it never lets up
Storm Runner.tip: The tempo (152 BPM) lines up well with a fast running cadence.

Library Rain.sound: plucked acoustic guitar, brushed snare, soft upright bass, rain on a window, vinyl crackle
Library Rain.structure: gentle loop-based form; the guitar melody changes slightly every eight bars and the rain gets louder near the end
Library Rain.lyrics: No lyrics. The mood is a rainy afternoon in a quiet library.
Library Rain.listen_when: studying, reading, rainy days, falling asleep, low-pressure creative work
Library Rain.skip_when: you need motivation or a beat to move to
Library Rain.tip: One of the most acoustic tracks in the catalog, so it suits listeners who dislike electronic sounds.

Gym Hero.sound: stadium drums, heavy synth bass, distorted synth stabs, a hard-hitting drop, chanted crowd vocals
Gym Hero.vocals: chanted, shouted pop vocals with a call-and-response hook
Gym Hero.structure: a building intro, verse, a chant pre-chorus, a big drop instead of a sung chorus, then a second drop with extra percussion
Gym Hero.lyrics: Pure motivation: one more rep, no excuses, be your own hero.
Gym Hero.skip_when: you asked for happy or feel-good pop; it is intense rather than cheerful
Gym Hero.tip: It is labeled pop but behaves like a workout track, which is why it sometimes ranks high for pop fans who wanted something sunnier.

Spacewalk Thoughts.sound: slow evolving synth pads, distant reverb-heavy piano, soft drones, faint radio static
Spacewalk Thoughts.structure: no beat and no fixed sections; it slowly swells and fades over the whole track
Spacewalk Thoughts.lyrics: No lyrics. It suggests floating weightlessly while looking back at Earth.
Spacewalk Thoughts.listen_when: sleep, meditation, deep focus, decompressing after a busy day
Spacewalk Thoughts.skip_when: you want rhythm, a melody to hum, or anything upbeat
Spacewalk Thoughts.tip: Best at low volume; it is designed to disappear into the background.

Coffee Shop Stories.sound: upright bass, brushed drums, gentle jazz piano
Coffee Shop Stories.structure: a classic jazz form: the piano states the melody, takes a relaxed solo, the bass takes a short solo, then the melody returns
Coffee Shop Stories.lyrics: No lyrics. It sounds like an afternoon in a small cafe with the rain outside.
Coffee Shop Stories.listen_when: cooking, dinner, reading, coffee-shop style background music, relaxed studying
Coffee Shop Stories.skip_when: you want something with a strong beat or vocals
Coffee Shop Stories.tip: Warm and acoustic, so it pairs well with lofi playlists even though it is real jazz.

Night Drive Loop.sound: pulsing synth arpeggios, gated reverb drums, analog synth bass, a dark synth lead melody
Night Drive Loop.structure: a slow fade-in, the main arpeggio loop, a melodic lead section, a breakdown, and a long fade-out
Night Drive Loop.lyrics: No lyrics. It evokes driving through empty city streets after midnight under neon lights.
Night Drive Loop.listen_when: night drives, late-night walks, gaming, moody focus sessions
Night Drive Loop.skip_when: you want something bright or cheerful
Night Drive Loop.tip: Shares its artist (Neon Echo) with Sunrise City but has the opposite mood: dark and cinematic instead of sunny.

Focus Flow.sound: steady lofi drum loop, soft electric piano, warm bass, vinyl crackle
Focus Flow.structure: one loop with very small changes so it never pulls attention away from work
Focus Flow.lyrics: No lyrics. Built specifically as focus music.
Focus Flow.listen_when: studying, coding, writing, any task that needs concentration
Focus Flow.skip_when: you are looking for emotion or a big moment; it is intentionally flat
Focus Flow.tip: Its mood is labeled focused rather than chill, so exact-mood searches for chill can miss it even though it fits.

Rooftop Lights.sound: jangly electric guitars, chiming acoustic guitar, handclaps, tambourine, warm bass, live drums
Rooftop Lights.vocals: warm, slightly lo-fi male lead vocal with group backing vocals
Rooftop Lights.structure: guitar riff intro, two verses, a big singalong chorus, a handclap breakdown, and a final chorus
Rooftop Lights.lyrics: A summer evening on a rooftop with friends, watching the city lights come on.
Rooftop Lights.listen_when: road trips, summer evenings, hanging out with friends, a happy mood that is not too polished
Rooftop Lights.skip_when: you want a very produced or electronic sound
Rooftop Lights.tip: A good pick for pop fans who want something happier and more handmade than mainstream pop.

Concrete Crown.sound: boom-bap drums, deep 808 bass, chopped soul sample, record scratches
Concrete Crown.vocals: confident male rap verses with a chanted hook
Concrete Crown.structure: short intro, three rap verses separated by a repeated hook, and a scratch outro
Concrete Crown.lyrics: Building yourself up from nothing and claiming your place: self-belief and hustle.
Concrete Crown.listen_when: walking to class, getting hyped before a presentation, workouts, confidence boosts
Concrete Crown.skip_when: you want calm or instrumental music
Concrete Crown.tip: The only hip-hop song in the catalog, so hip-hop fans will often see lofi tracks as related picks.

Moonlit Sonata Redux.sound: solo grand piano with long sustained notes and soft pedal
Moonlit Sonata Redux.structure: a slow opening theme, a gentle middle section in a brighter key, and a return to the opening theme that fades out
Moonlit Sonata Redux.lyrics: No lyrics. Wistful and introspective, like thinking about the past late at night.
Moonlit Sonata Redux.listen_when: sleep, reading, studying, quiet evenings, reflective or sad moods
Moonlit Sonata Redux.skip_when: you want energy or a beat
Moonlit Sonata Redux.tip: The most acoustic track in the catalog (acousticness 0.97).

Iron Tempest.sound: down-tuned distorted guitars, blast-beat drums, heavy bass guitar, guitar solo
Iron Tempest.structure: a feedback intro, crushing riffs, two verses, a half-time breakdown, a shredding guitar solo, and a final assault
Iron Tempest.lyrics: Rage and defiance: a storm that tears everything down.
Iron Tempest.listen_when: intense workouts, venting anger, heavy lifting
Iron Tempest.skip_when: you want anything calm, happy or acoustic
Iron Tempest.tip: The highest-energy (0.97) and fastest (168 BPM) song in the catalog.

Dusty Porch Swing.sound: acoustic guitar, fiddle, slide guitar, upright bass, light brushed drums, harmonica
Dusty Porch Swing.vocals: warm female country vocal with a harmony on the chorus
Dusty Porch Swing.structure: fiddle intro, storytelling verses, a gentle chorus, a fiddle solo, and a quiet final verse
Dusty Porch Swing.lyrics: Remembering childhood summers on a grandparent's farmhouse porch: lemonade, crickets and simpler times.
Dusty Porch Swing.listen_when: cooking, dinner, slow Sunday afternoons, nostalgic moods, road trips through the countryside
Dusty Porch Swing.skip_when: you want high energy or electronic production
Dusty Porch Swing.tip: A good fallback for folk or polka fans, since it shares acoustic instruments with those styles.

Velvet Hours.sound: soft electric piano, smooth bass, gentle programmed drums, string pads
Velvet Hours.vocals: silky, breathy female R&B vocal with layered harmonies
Velvet Hours.structure: a slow-groove intro, two verses, a smooth chorus, a vocal-run bridge, and a long fade
Velvet Hours.lyrics: A slow evening with someone you love, where time seems to stretch.
Velvet Hours.listen_when: date night, dinner, late evenings, romantic moods
Velvet Hours.skip_when: you want to dance hard or need a strong motivational push
Velvet Hours.tip: The only song in the catalog with a romantic mood.

Laser Bloom.sound: sparkling synth leads, supersaw chords, four-on-the-floor kick, a long riser build, a huge drop, sidechained bass
Laser Bloom.vocals: short chopped vocal samples only; mostly instrumental
Laser Bloom.structure: intro, a long build with a riser, a massive drop, a breakdown, a second build and a bigger final drop
Laser Bloom.lyrics: Almost no lyrics; the chopped vocal hints at a night that feels endless.
Laser Bloom.skip_when: you want acoustic, calm or lyric-driven music
Laser Bloom.tip: The most euphoric track in the catalog and one of the least acoustic (acousticness 0.04).

Island Postcard.sound: off-beat guitar skank, warm bass line, organ bubble, hand percussion, melodica
Island Postcard.vocals: easygoing male vocal with call-and-response backing vocals
Island Postcard.structure: a relaxed groove that stays steady through two verses, a sing-along chorus, and a melodica solo
Island Postcard.lyrics: Postcards from a beach town where nobody is in a hurry.
Island Postcard.listen_when: beach days, lazy Sundays, cooking, relaxed hangouts, summer
Island Postcard.skip_when: you want intensity or very low energy for sleep
Island Postcard.tip: The only reggae song in the catalog and the closest match for reggaeton or Latin requests.

Paper Boats.sound: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft cello, light piano in the last chorus
Paper Boats.structure: a quiet guitar intro, three verses that grow slightly fuller, and a whispered final line
Paper Boats.lyrics: Letting someone go, like folding paper boats and watching them drift away.
Paper Boats.listen_when: heartbreak, rainy days, quiet reflection, sad moods
Paper Boats.skip_when: you need to feel better quickly or want energy
Paper Boats.tip: One of the saddest and most acoustic songs in the catalog (acousticness 0.91).

Crossroads Blue.sound: crying electric lead guitar, Hammond organ, walking bass, slow shuffle drums, harmonica
Crossroads Blue.structure: a twelve-bar blues form: three verses, a long guitar solo, and a final verse
Crossroads Blue.lyrics: Standing at a crossroads after losing everything and deciding which way to go.
Crossroads Blue.listen_when: heartbreak, late nights, sad but soulful moods, slow evenings
Crossroads Blue.skip_when: you want upbeat or high-energy music
Crossroads Blue.tip: Sadder than most songs in the catalog but with more groove than the folk ballads.

Starlight Sprint.sound: glossy synths, punchy electronic drums, sliding synth bass, a dance-break beat switch, layered group vocals
Starlight Sprint.vocals: group vocals with rapid-fire rap verses and a soaring sung chorus
Starlight Sprint.structure: a cold-open chorus, fast verses, a pre-chorus build, the chorus, a dance break, and a key-change final chorus
Starlight Sprint.lyrics: Racing toward a dream under the stars, with friends cheering you on.
Starlight Sprint.listen_when: parties, dancing, workouts, road trips, any time you want maximum upbeat energy
Starlight Sprint.skip_when: you need calm, focus or acoustic music
Starlight Sprint.tip: Very happy and very high energy at the same time, a combination few other songs in the catalog have.
